scope: Manual observations on development examples; not a complete corpus audit

findings.observation: The rendered receipt has Item, Qty and Amount columns. It has no separate Unit Price column. Labels nevertheless provide unit_price for every row. Nemotron retained missing unit_price rather than computing it from quantity and amount.
findings.action: Preserve strict full-row scores. Also report description/quantity/amount accuracy separately; never count inferred unit prices as printed extraction.

findings.observation: Company name is stacked across three title lines. Table uses Value for line amount. Net Total, VAT Total and EUR Total are distinct.
findings.action: Development parser fixes join title lines, recognize Value and keep tax/net totals separate.

findings.observation: Invoice Number literally displays None, while issue date and amount due are separate nearby columns. The labelled invoice_number is null.
findings.action: Do not invent an invoice ID. Read the date from its own column.
